findings.summary: The `commentSymbolMap` variable is declared and populated but never read, which will cause an ESLint failure.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the `commentSymbolMap` variable and all its `.set()` calls.

findings.summary: The `DECLARATION_PATTERN` regex fails to match class methods that use access modifiers like `public`, `private`, or `protected`.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the method matching part of the regex to optionally allow access modifiers, e.g., `^\s*(?:(?:public|private|protected|static)\s+)?(?:async\s+)?(\w+)\s*\(`.

findings.summary: Multiple comments in the same file that resolve to the same declaration will push duplicate symbol sections to the context array.
findings.suggested_fix: Maintain a set of `seenSymbolsForFile` to avoid pushing the same declaration content multiple times per file.
